note: Core 4 (README: choose partner/friend/family examples plus the private-party no-action case; record the real sample size and limitations). A curated selection BY REFERENCE: every example points at an existing case in decision-cases.json (the owner-only decision loop) or evaluation-cases.json (approval -> policy -> recipient consent -> nudge). No case, story, candidate or expected outcome is copied here; expected outcomes and forbidden-disclosure labels are read from the source fixture at run time, so a relabel there is the only way to change one. 'covers' and 'why' are DS selection notes, not labels. Selected after the Core 1-3 labels were written and passing; nothing was relabeled for this selection.
